WITH export_rows AS ( SELECT l.id::text AS record_id,l.entry_type AS record_type,NULL::text AS adjustment_type, NULL::text AS related_ledger_id,NULL::text AS related_ledger_title,l.lifecycle_status AS record_status, to_char(l.business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00' AS business_time, l.business_date::text,l.product_name_snapshot,l.income_name,l.payer_name_snapshot, l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot,l.income_category_name_snapshot, l.unit_name_snapshot,l.unit_price::text,l.quantity::text,l.calculated_amount::text,l.paid_amount::text, l.income_amount::text,NULL::text AS adjustment_amount,l.funding_channel_name_snapshot, l.purchase_channel_name_snapshot,l.location_label_name_snapshot,l.note,l.product_id::text,l.payer_id::text, l.primary_category_id::text,l.secondary_category_id::text,l.income_category_id::text,l.unit_id::text, l.funding_channel_id::text AS funding_channel_reference,l.purchase_channel_id::text,l.location_label_id::text, l.version::text,to_char(l.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00' AS created_at, to_char(l.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00' AS updated_at, to_char(l.deleted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00' AS deleted_at, to_char(l.purge_after AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00' AS purge_after, l.funding_channel_id AS filter_funding_channel_id, concat_ws(' ',l.product_name_snapshot,l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot, l.income_name,l.payer_name_snapshot,l.income_category_name_snapshot,l.funding_channel_name_snapshot, l.purchase_channel_name_snapshot,l.location_label_name_snapshot,l.note) AS search_text, l.primary_category_id AS filter_primary_category_id,l.secondary_category_id AS filter_secondary_category_id, l.product_id AS filter_product_id,l.unit_id AS filter_unit_id,l.purchase_channel_id AS filter_purchase_channel_id, l.location_label_id AS filter_location_label_id,l.income_category_id AS filter_income_category_id, l.payer_id AS filter_payer_id,l.income_name AS filter_income_name,l.id AS filter_entry_id, l.business_time AS filter_business_time FROM ledger_entry l WHERE l.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid UNION ALL SELECT a.id::text,'ADJUSTMENT',a.adjustment_type,a.original_expense_id::text, CASE WHEN l.entry_type='EXPENSE' THEN l.product_name_snapshot ELSE l.income_name END,a.status, to_char(a.business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00', a.business_date::text,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL, a.amount::text,NULL,NULL,NULL,a.note,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,a.version::text, to_char(a.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00', to_char(a.updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00', to_char(a.deleted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00', to_char(a.purge_after AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') || '+08:00', l.funding_channel_id AS filter_funding_channel_id, concat_ws(' ',l.product_name_snapshot,l.primary_category_name_snapshot,l.secondary_category_name_snapshot, l.funding_channel_name_snapshot,a.note,CASE a.adjustment_type WHEN 'REFUND' THEN '退款' ELSE '报销' END) AS search_text, l.primary_category_id,l.secondary_category_id,l.product_id,l.unit_id,l.purchase_channel_id, l.location_label_id,NULL::uuid,NULL::uuid,NULL::varchar,a.id,a.business_time FROM expense_adjustment a JOIN ledger_entry l ON l.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND l.id=a.original_expense_id WHERE a.tenant_id=current_setting('app.tenant_id')::uuid ) SELECT record_id,record_type,adjustment_type,related_ledger_id,related_ledger_title,record_status, business_time,business_date,product_name_snapshot,income_name,payer_name_snapshot, primary_category_name_snapshot,secondary_category_name_snapshot,income_category_name_snapshot, unit_name_snapshot,unit_price,quantity,calculated_amount,paid_amount,income_amount,adjustment_amount, funding_channel_name_snapshot,purchase_channel_name_snapshot,location_label_name_snapshot,note, product_id,payer_id,primary_category_id,secondary_category_id,income_category_id,unit_id, funding_channel_reference,purchase_channel_id,location_label_id,version,created_at,updated_at,deleted_at,purge_after FROM export_rows WHERE true
AND business_date::date BETWEEN #{p.startDate} AND #{p.endDate}
AND ((record_type IN ('EXPENSE','INCOME') AND record_status='ACTIVE') OR (record_type='ADJUSTMENT' AND record_status='EFFECTIVE'))
AND ((record_type IN ('EXPENSE','INCOME') AND record_status='TRASHED') OR (record_type='ADJUSTMENT' AND record_status='TRASHED'))
AND record_type=#{p.entryType} AND record_type IN ('EXPENSE','ADJUSTMENT') AND filter_funding_channel_id=#{p.fundingId} AND filter_primary_category_id=#{p.primaryCategoryId} AND filter_secondary_category_id=#{p.secondaryCategoryId} AND filter_product_id=#{p.productId} AND filter_unit_id=#{p.unitId} AND filter_purchase_channel_id=#{p.purchaseChannelId} AND filter_location_label_id=#{p.locationLabelId} AND filter_income_category_id=#{p.incomeCategoryId} AND filter_payer_id=#{p.payerId} AND filter_income_name=#{p.incomeName} AND filter_entry_id=#{p.entryId} AND filter_secondary_category_id IS NULL AND filter_purchase_channel_id IS NULL AND filter_location_label_id IS NULL AND extract(isodow FROM filter_business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::int=#{p.expenseWeekday} AND extract(hour FROM filter_business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') < 6 AND extract(hour FROM filter_business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') BETWEEN 6 AND 11 AND extract(hour FROM filter_business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') BETWEEN 12 AND 17 AND extract(hour FROM filter_business_time AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') >= 18 AND search_text ILIKE #{p.keyword} ESCAPE '\'
ORDER BY business_date DESC,business_time DESC,created_at DESC,record_id DESC
